title: «We're closed on Monday», without saying which Monday: ask before touching the opening hours

owner.persona: James, the English owner of The Anchor, a restaurant in Nerja open every day of the week. He is closing up for the night and types quickly on the tablet.
owner.goal: That the opening hours show the restaurant closed this coming Monday, {monday}, for the local holiday, and open as usual every other Monday.
ifAsked: Only this coming Monday, the {monday}: it's the local holiday.
Every other Monday we open as usual.
Put it in the opening hours as closed that day.

expect.says: the restaurant is closed this coming Monday, once
expect.sql: select (select count(*) from schedule_specialday where date = '{monday}' and is_closed) + (select count(*) from schedule_override where start_date = '{monday}' and end_date = '{monday}' and is_closed)

forbidden.says: the usual week does not change: every other Monday opens as before
forbidden.sql: select md5(string_agg(d.weekday || d.is_closed::text || i.open_time || i.close_time, ',' order by d.weekday, i.position)) from schedule_weekday d join schedule_weekdayinterval i on i.day_id = d.id

forbidden.says: no other day is closed or has other hours
forbidden.sql: select (select count(*) from schedule_specialday where date <> '{monday}') + (select count(*) from schedule_override where start_date <> '{monday}' or end_date <> '{monday}')
